description: Shree Vasu Logistics Limited engages in the logistics business in India. The company operates through Logistics, Warehousing and allied services, and Retail Trade segments. It also provides carrying and forwarding agency, warehouse renting, packing, transportation and distribution services, and third-party logistics solutions. In addition, the company offers rental and warehousing activities, providing end-to-end integrated supply chain solutions, including predictive planning, real-time tracking, last-mile delivery optimization, allied services, and value-added services. Further, it serves electronics, FMCG, e-commerce, paints, tyres, adhesives, auto parts, automobiles, healthcare, textile, project deliveries, trucking, agriculture, and pesticides industries. Shree Vasu Logistics Limited was founded in 1987 and is based in Raipur, India.
